description: Use this when the user asks how a player's team does with him on or off the floor, his clutch or garbage-time splits, or how he plays with or without a teammate (NFL: target, carry and red-zone shares with or without a teammate). Returns those splits for the season (NBA: on/off, situations and milestones, `detail` naming the ones wanted; NFL: his usage row and the team's busiest, `detail` "full" for every player). Requires Keel Stats Pro; the answer says so when the account has none. Not for season averages or recent games: use player_profile.

detail.description: "compact" (default), "full" (NFL: every player of the team's usage), or a comma-separated list of NBA sections: "on_off", "situations", "milestones".

player_id.description: Numeric player ID from the search tool.

season.description: Optional season year. Defaults to the current season.

teammate_id.description: Optional numeric teammate player ID to drill into specific two-man / with-without splits.
